pins.name: dxil-spirv
pins.license: MIT (Copyright (c) 2019-2022 Hans-Kristian Arntzen for Valve Corporation; SPDX MIT)
pins.role: Stage 1 of the pipeline: DXIL (SM6) -> SPIR-V; via its dxbc-spirv submodule it also covers legacy DXBC (SM5). C API stable per README. No Sony material.

pins.name: vkd3d-proton (vkd3d-shader + vkd3d-compiler)
pins.license: LGPL-2.1 (COPYING) -- NOTE: weak copyleft. We use it as an offline build-time tool only; shader OUTPUT is data, not a derived work of the tool. Never static-link into any distributed binary without relink-provision compliance. Alternative stage-1 (dxil-spirv, MIT) is preferred if licensing ever becomes distributive.
pins.role: Second stage-1 route: libs/vkd3d-shader/dxbc.c + programs/vkd3d-compiler (vkd3d_shader_compile_dxbc -> SPIR-V, source VKD3D_SHADER_SOURCE_DXBC_TPF).

pins.name: Mesa ACO (source pin, no clone)
pins.role: Stage 2: NIR -> RDNA2 machine code (gfx10 family). Pin is main-branch raw files; at build time pin an exact release TAG. Full Mesa tree NOT cloned (size).
pins.caveat: No PS5 (gfx1034-class) target exists in public Mesa; ACO targets gfx1030-class RDNA2. The console-specific packaging is learned ONLY from the game's own shipped shader chunks (M1).

pins.name: cityhash (Google reference)
pins.role: Reference for the pure-python CityHash64 port used to verify UE IoStore lower_utf16_cityhash derivations against the game's own TOC container ids (verification oracle documented in cap12-research-notes.md).

pins.name: cityhash64.py (our port)
pins.role: Pure-stdlib CityHash64 + lower_utf16_cityhash; VERIFIED against 6 local container-id oracles (mod + 5 base utocs all match).

not_pinned.name: LLVM (AMDGPU backend)
not_pinned.why: repo ~4.6 GB; stage-2 FALLBACK only (llc -mtriple=amdgcn--amdhsa -mcpu=gfx1030). Pin a release tarball at build time in the AC-power window.

not_pinned.name: DirectXShaderCompiler (dxc)
not_pinned.why: DXIL disassembly; dxil-spirv's checkout_dxc.sh fetches it at build time; no Mac pin needed at design stage.
